Name: Pink Bow Theme 2.0 for Smartphone (Custom Skin)
Author: stcindy2020
Description:
[b]Hi everyone![/b] 🌸An update!
I recently started using the amazing
[b][size=4][font=Arial Black][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/46248?tab=posts&BH=0]Smartphone[/url] [/font][/size][/b]mod by[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/HaPyke] [i][b]HaPyke[/b][/i] [/url]and wanted a cute, pink aesthetic for my game. So I created this simple Pink Bow theme using AI tool and Photoshop for my personal playthrough and decided to share it here in case anyone else likes this style!
[b]✨ What this theme changes:[/b]
[list]
[*]The outer phone casing and background wallpaper.[/*]
[*]All main menu App icons (Camera, Social, Settings, Photos, Texts, Notifications, Calendar, App store.) replaced with customized cute pink versions.[/*]
[/list]
[b][size=5]🛠️ Installation:[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*]Make sure you have installed the required core mod:[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/46248?tab=posts&BH=0] [b]Smartphone[/b][/url].[/*]
[*]Download and extract this ZIP file.[/*]
[*]Drop the extracted folder (named
[code]Pink_Bow_Theme[/code]or similar) into your
[code]Mods/Smartphone/phone_themes/[/code]directory.[/*]
[*]Launch the game, open the Smartphone Settings, and select this theme from the dropdown menu![/*]
[/list][b][size=5]Credits:[/size][/b] All programming credit goes to the original author [i][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/HaPyke][b]HaPyke[/b][/url] [/i]for creating the wonderful Smartphone mod.
Enjoy your farming life! 💕



Hi everyone! 🌸 [b]An important update![/b]
Since the amazing[b][size=4][font=Arial Black] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/46248?tab=posts&BH=0]Smartphone[/url][/font][/size][/b] mod by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/HaPyke][i][b]HaPyke[/b][/i][/url] has recently been split into [b]three separate mods[/b], I’ve updated my Pink Bow theme to match! ✨ Because of this change, getting the full aesthetic now requires downloading three separate files.
✨ [b]What this theme changes:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]File ① (Main Smartphone):[/b] Changes the outer phone casing, background wallpaper, and main menu App icons (Camera, Settings, Photos, App store, etc.) to customized cute pink versions.[/*]
[*][b]File ② (Social App):[/b] Replaces the asset files for the Stardew Social features.[/*]
[*][b]File ③ (Messenger App):[/b] Replaces the asset files for the Messaging features.[/*]
[/list]🛠️ [b]Installation Guide (Please read carefully!):[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Make sure you have installed all three required core mods from HaPyke ( [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/46248?tab=posts&BH=0][b]Smartphone[/b][/url] , [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/48348][b]Stardew Social[/b][/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/48347][b]Messenger[/b][/url]).[/*]
[*]Download and extract this updated ZIP file.[/*]
[*][b]For the Main Smartphone Theme:[/b] Drop the extracted
[code]Pink_Bow_Theme[/code]folder into your
[code]Mods/Smartphone/phone_themes/[/code]directory. You can select this from the in-game Smartphone Settings dropdown menu![/*]
[*][b]For the Social & Messenger Themes (⚠️ Important Workaround):[/b] Currently, there is a minor bug where new custom theme folders for the Social and Messenger apps do not show up in the phone's theme selection page. To fix this, I have directly replaced the images inside the
[code]default[/code]asset folders with my new pink ones.[/*]
[*][b]Backup Info:[/b] The original default files have been safely backed up and renamed to
[code]default2[/code]inside the folders. Simply drop my provided Social and Messenger asset folders into their respective Mod directories and let them overwrite![/*]
[/list][i](If any fellow modders know the cause of this menu bug, please let me know in the comments!)[/i] 🙏
💖 [b]Credits:[/b] A massive thank you to the original author [b][i][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/HaPyke]HaPyke[/url][/i] [/b]for their continued support, updates, and for creating this wonderful mod series. All programming credit goes to them!
Enjoy your farming life! 💕
